id.description: Unique snake_case or kebab-case report identifier, scoped to the module

display_name.description: Human-readable French-first label shown in the admin console

metrics.description: Canonical metric names — each MUST exist in the dbt semantic dictionary

dimensions.description: Canonical dimension names — each MUST exist in the dbt semantic dictionary

chart_type.description: Hint consumed by the module's widget renderer — no rendering logic in the schema

order_by.description: Canonical metric or dimension to sort by (e.g. 'date', 'sessions DESC')

top_n.description: Optional: limit rows to top N (useful for page/campaign breakdowns)

narrative_prompt.description: Domain-specific prompt fragment injected into the LLM summary for this report. Must be ≤200 chars. Sets the expert 'voice' (e.g. 'Analyse en termes SEO: mouvements de position…').

default_days.description: Default lookback in days when no explicit date_range is given (e.g. 30, 90)

connectors.description: Optional: list of connector names to include. Defaults to the report's own module. Use for cross-source reports.
